messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered -> PID-9143. Source: inference-gateway (us-west-2). Symptom: spike in 5xxs across frontend -> runtime pool. Started at 2026-03-15T09:03:21Z. Severity: P2. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PID-9143 :rotating_light:
Harper: acknowledged - I'm oncall, jumping in.
Harper: quick check on console — request latency looks OK, but 5xx rate shot up at ~09:03.
metrics-bot: 5xx rate (5m avg) for inference-gateway rose from 0.3% -> 8.7% across us-west-2.
Maya: logs show repeated backend failures. grabbing sample from runtime-23 group:
```
2026-03-15T09:03:21Z inference-gateway error host=runtime-23-7 container=runtime msg="handle_request: model_exec: KVCache OOM
 stack=github.com/redwood/runtime/kvcache.(*Cache).Alloc+0x12f
" request_id=req_0a1b2c
2026-03-15T09:03:25Z inference-gateway error host=runtime-23-2 container=runtime msg="handle_request: model_exec: KVCache OOM" request_id=req_0a1b2d
2026-03-15T09:03:31Z inference-gateway error host=runtime-23-7 container=runtime msg="worker panic: allocate failed" request_id=req_0a1b2e
```
Sam: same cluster nodes only (runtime-23*). We had a model rollout at 09:00 that pushed quantized-v2 to that pool.
Sam: looks like that variant increased KV pressure; maybe cache sizing regression.
Leo: current log-based alert "gateway-5xx-spike" is broad (counts 5xx across all messages). We'll get noisy if we keep it. Proposal: add a targeted signature for "KVCache OOM" and tune the count threshold for runtime pools.
Maya: proposed quick rule (for emergency deploy):
```
name: kvcache-oom-signature
scope: k8s_container.labels.pool=="runtime-23"
query: jsonPayload.message =~ "KVCache OOM|worker panic: allocate failed"
window: 5m
threshold: count > 3
suppression: auto-mute 10m after runbook-trigger
severity: P2
```
This will page the oncall for actual backend OOMs but not every transient 500.
Harper: while we iterate, do we want a fast mitigation? I can roll traffic off runtime-23 or roll back the model rollout. Which is faster?
Sam: rollback is quick. Command: ```redwoodctl rollout rollback --model=quantized-v2 --from-pool=runtime-23 --to=stable-v1```
Sam: I'm going to trigger the rollback now.
incident-bot: automated action queued: rollout rollback started by Sam at 2026-03-15T09:12:08Z. Progress link: https://console.redwood.example/rollouts/rl-8891
Harper: I'm also temporarily muting the high-level "gateway-5xx-spike" alert for us-west-2 to prevent noise while rollback completes (reason: mitigation in flight).
metrics-bot: rollback observed: traffic shifted off runtime-23 -> stable pool by 09:16:40Z. 5xx rate dropping.
Maya: verification logs show no new KVCache OOMs after 09:16. sample:
```
2026-03-15T09:17:03Z inference-gateway info host=runtime-23-7 msg="healthcheck pass" request_id=-
2026-03-15T09:17:10Z inference-gateway info host=runtime-22-3 msg="request served" request_id=req_0a1b3a
```
Harper: 5xxs back to baseline in dashboard. closing active pager.
incident-bot: PID-9143 marked resolved at 2026-03-15T09:19:27Z (root cause: KVCache sizing regression in quantized-v2 rollout; rollback mitigated impact).
Sam: follow-ups: create a post-incident ticket to add a permanent log signature and a granular alert targeting KVCache OOM across all runtime pools; also add a pre-rollout smoke test that exercises KV cache under realistic token loads.
Maya: suggested long-term alert rule (for config repo):
```
- id: log-kvcache-oom
  description: Detect persistent KVCache OOMs (ignore single transient hits)
  source: logs
  filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND jsonPayload.message =~ "KVCache OOM|worker panic: allocate failed"
  group_by: k8s_container.labels.pool, jsonPayload.host
  window: 10m
  threshold: count >= 5
  dedup: 2m
  notify: oncall, ticket-queue
  runbook: /runbooks/kvcache-oom.md
```
We should also add a regex exclusion for known benign stack traces in the gateway's transient reconnects to reduce false positives.
Leo: I'll spin up a short-lived dashboard widget that shows KVCache OOM count by pool + recent rollouts, and add it to the incident runbook.
Harper: I'll file the PD ticket linking this thread and assign to Sam/Maya for patch + rollout gating. Also set a 24h follow-up meeting.
Sam: will add rollback gating to rollout pipeline and add the smoke test.
Maya: I'll land the log signature and the alert rule in observability repo after review.
Harper: thanks all. marking postmortem required (P2 but customer impact minimal due to quick mitigation).
metrics-bot: creating follow-up ticket T-30412 in tracker and linking to PID-9143.
Harper: good job. :thumbsup:
